meta.title: Intake-Selected Technical Template: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and verify the intake-selected technical template is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Requester / End User and verify the template is available, including comparing both outcomes in the same tenant.
Verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan.
